## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes and `omarchy plugin validate .` exits 0
- [ ] Containment check re-run, if this changes how tiles are launched or tiled
- [ ] Guide page / spec / CHANGELOG (Unreleased) updated where behaviour changed
- [ ] Extension changed? Worker script renamed and `manifest.json` updated
- [ ] ADR added for a durable design choice
- [ ] Panel changes shown with an offscreen render (`tests/preview.sh`), not a desktop screenshot
- [ ] No personal paths, stream URLs, device names, serials or addresses
